subject: Slate pace reprofile & procurement gating — MAP and evaluation dependencies
messages:
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Slate pace reprofile & procurement gating — MAP and evaluation dependencies

Maria / Acme procurement team —

Quick note on where we landed after today's sync. The evaluation plan (MAP-v2 attached) still has two high-impact dependencies that are gating acceptance:

- Security signoff for sandbox access (sec-team needs JIT access by 9/22).
- Procurement confirmation of a partial MPA (legal + PO cadence) to let us run a 2-week canary before full go-live.

Based on those constraints the close runway needs to be reprofiled. Proposed near-term options:

A) Short roll-forward: move close to 2025-10-30, keep the eval plan intact, and schedule canary on 10/06.
B) Two-stage: partial MPA + sandbox carveout to unblock feature evaluation by 9/29, final sign-off 10/15.
C) Contain risk: push acceptance gate but keep product integration milestones — we will supply temporary hosted keys for the canary.

I've attached an annotated risk log (close-risk-log-20250915.csv) and a procurement blocker spreadsheet for your review. Ben has sketched mitigation steps below; Ben / Jordan, can you review and confirm the technical mitigations and escalation path?

Maria — please confirm the minimal procurement/legal artefacts you need to accept option B (partial MPA). If we don't have commitment by COB 9/22 we will elevate to execs per the escalation path in the MAP.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Sr. Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: MAP-v2.docx (annotated), procurement_blocker_list.xlsx, close-risk-log-20250915.csv

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acme.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-15T12:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Slate pace reprofile & procurement gating — MAP and evaluation dependencies

Thanks Kimberly —

Appreciate the clear options. A couple items from procurement/security side:

- Security: our InfoSec team requires a SOC-2 evidence pack and an IP/ingress matrix before they approve sandbox access. We can fast-track but need those docs by EOD 9/18.
- Procurement: we can sign a short-form MPA for the canary but procurement wants an explicit rollback clause and acceptance criteria.

I'll loop legal this afternoon and confirm what they will accept for the partial MPA. If Redwood can provide the SOC-2 snippets (or pointer to your compliance pack) and a clear rollback window, we should be able to do option B.

Also — please confirm the exact token/usage caps during the canary so procurement can model costs.

—Maria
Maria Lopez
Director, Platform Integrations | Acme Health
maria.lopez@acme.com
+1 (617) 555-0188

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acme.com>
Cc: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-16T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Slate pace reprofile & procurement gating — MAP and evaluation dependencies

Maria / Kimberly —

Adding technical context from the risk log: I've pulled three entries that are highest priority for the canary unblock:

1) Sandbox network allowlist latency — we can provision a temporary VPC peering + IP allowlist in 24 hours if Acme provides the CIDR ranges and primary egress endpoints. (Mitigation: expedite with infra ops).

2) Token quotas — we'll configure a capped API key (rate-limited + quota) specifically for the canary to address procurement cost modeling. Proposed defaults: 100k tokens/day, burst 20k. We can tune down further.

3) Data residency logging — we will enable audit logs for the canary workspace and provide daily aggregated reports.

If you confirm CIDR and acceptance criteria, we can target a sandbox handoff on 9/22 for a 9/24 canary start.

I'll attach a short runbook (see MAP-v2 doc) and the updated procurement_blocker_list.xlsx that maps each blocker to mitigation and owner.

Ben Carter
Director, Solutions Engineering | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: 2025-09-17T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Slate pace reprofile & procurement gating — MAP and evaluation dependencies

Jordan —

Per Ben and Maria's notes, procurement has signaled they will consider a partial MPA but require legal language around rollback and acceptance windows. If we don't see a firm commitment from Acme procurement by end of day 2025-09-22 we need to escalate per the MAP escalation ladder.

Action items for you:
- Draft a 1-page exec summary for Greg (COO) that outlines the impact to revenue recognition (approx. 2–3 week slip) and mitigation options (partial MPA, sponsored canary credits, or push to 10/30).
- Prepare an ask for Legal (bullet list) so we can get a short-form MPA template in <48 hours.

I will keep Acme updated and offer a sponsored canary credit (up to $10k) to de-risk their procurement review. Please mark this as high priority; if I don't have the exec summary by EOD 9/18 I will follow up.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

From: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@acme.com>
Date: 2025-09-18T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Slate pace reprofile & procurement gating — MAP and evaluation dependencies

Ack — I'll draft the exec summary and run to Greg + Legal this afternoon.

Draft will include:
- Short description of the blocker (security & procurement gating)
- Financial impact estimate (NRR risk window and revenue deferral ~2–3 weeks)
- Recommended path (partial MPA + 2-week canary; sponsored credit to cover trial usage; contingency roll to 10/30)
- Required legal bullets for rollback & acceptance criteria

I'll send the first cut by 17:00 PT and include Legal on the thread.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
